name: Notifo Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted multichannel notification server with REST API, templates, delivery tracking, and email, SMS, web push and webhook integrations; no software usage quota or expiry stated.
watch_out: Requires own server, database, HTTPS domain/TLS and secret rotation; outbound SMTP, SMS and third-party notification providers can charge separately. Hosted app.notifo.io is not the free offer.
